label: ERT (rugby)
hint: Mud, scrums and a very long third half
blurb: The rugby team: training in the rain, matches against other schools, and a third half that lasts until Sunday.

effects.text: Your first scrum in Cergy leaves a bruise shaped like friendship.

label: EFC (football)
blurb: The football club: five-a-side on Tuesdays, eleven-a-side drama every weekend, one group chat that never sleeps.

effects.text: You score once in your first match. You will tell this story for twenty years.

label: EDC (dance club)
hint: Midnight choreos, a gala in spring
blurb: The dance club: rehearsals at midnight, a spring gala, and sore muscles you didn't know existed.

effects.text: Eight counts, forty mistakes, one standing ovation at the gala.

label: Boxing club
blurb: The boxing club: skipping ropes, sparring, and a coach who believes discipline is a love language.

effects.text: You learn to take a punch. Exam season will feel lighter.

label: BDS (sports office)
hint: Every tournament, every bus, every early run
blurb: The sports office runs every tournament, every bus and every 7AM run on the plateau, wind included.

effects.text: You now own a clipboard, a whistle and the phone numbers of three bus companies.

label: Comedia (theatre)
hint: Improv on Mondays, ego all week
blurb: The theatre troupe: improv on Mondays, a classic on Fridays, and the best-dressed people on campus.

effects.text: You forget your line on opening night and improvise something better. A star is born, slightly sweaty.

label: NSB (photography)
hint: You'll never see light the same way
blurb: The photography club: sunrise shoots, darkroom nights and very strong feelings about grain.

effects.text: Your shot of the Cergy lake in the fog wins the club contest. You print it. You frame it. You stare at it.

label: LDM (restaurant reviews)
blurb: The restaurant-review club: weekly tastings, ruthless ratings, a blog read by four hundred very hungry students.

effects.text: Your review of the canteen's lasagne goes viral on campus. The chef is not amused.

label: Utopia (AI association)
blurb: ESSEC's AI association: conferences, hackathons, and long debates about whether the robots will be nice.

effects.text: Your first hackathon: 36 hours, 9 coffees, 1 demo that works exactly once, live, in front of the jury.

label: Automatants (AI club)
blurb: CentraleSupélec's AI club: reading groups, GPU clusters and leaderboard competitions that end at 4AM.

effects.text: You train your first neural network on a borrowed GPU. It recognises cats. Mostly.

label: Kryptosphère (blockchain)
hint: DeFi, tokens and a lot of optimism
blurb: The blockchain association: DeFi workshops, token debates and a whiteboard that has said 'WAGMI' since 2021.

effects.text: You buy a token 'for research'. It goes up 40%, then down 90%. Research complete.

label: ECC (economics club)
blurb: The economics club: talks with central bankers, inflation debates and a very competitive monetary policy game.

effects.text: You win the monetary policy game by raising rates on everyone's feelings.

label: ESSEC Transaction
blurb: The M&A association: case studies, valuation nights, suits on Tuesdays and a LinkedOut feed full of handshakes.

effects.text: You learn to say 'synergies' with a straight face. A banker gives you a business card. You frame it, ironically.

label: CentraleSupélec Finance
blurb: The finance club: quant brainteasers, trading simulations and spreadsheet shortcuts as a personality.

effects.text: You solve the famous 'how many tennis balls fit in a plane' question. The answer is always 'it depends'.

label: Junior-Entreprise
blurb: The student consultancy: real clients, real invoices, real deadlines, and a président who sends emails at 1AM.

effects.text: Your first client pays on time. Your second does not. You learn more from the second.

label: Genius (entrepreneurship)
blurb: The entrepreneurship club: pitch nights, startup weekends and a co-founder in every corridor.

effects.text: You pitch an app at a startup weekend. It wins 'most disruptive'. Nobody knows what it disrupts.

label: Ultra (supporters)
blurb: The supporters' club: drums, chants and giant banners at every inter-school match, win or lose.

effects.text: You lose your voice at your first match. You find it again, mostly, by Wednesday.

label: Peak (extreme sports)
blurb: The extreme-sports club: climbing walls, ski weekends and paragliding trips your family doesn't need to hear about.

effects.text: You hang off a cliff in the Alps, laughing. Your mum finds out from a group photo.

label: Delta (humanitarian trip)
hint: A year of fundraising, a trip that matters
blurb: A year of fundraising for a humanitarian project in South Africa, then a few weeks on site with the partner school.

footprint.label: Delta trip flight to South Africa

effects.text: You paint a classroom, teach a coding workshop and come back with a very different idea of 'busy'.

label: Impact (sustainability)
blurb: The sustainability association: climate workshops, a campus compost project and endless meetings with facilities.

effects.text: You run your first climate workshop. A finance student leaves very quiet and very thoughtful.

label: OSER (tutoring)
hint: Tutor kids told this wasn't for them
blurb: Weekly tutoring for high schoolers who were told grandes écoles weren't for people like them.

effects.text: Your tutee gets into prépa. You cry in the RER. Nobody judges.

label: HumaCS (solidarity)
blurb: International solidarity projects, from water pumps to coding camps, run with partner associations abroad.

effects.text: Your project spreadsheet has more tabs than your life. Every one of them matters to someone.
